svg.title: The Ming empire in 1582: capitals, workshops and ports
svg.desc: Nanjing and Suzhou are near the lower Yangzi. Beijing and Shanhai Pass are in the north. The Grand Canal runs north from the lower Yangzi. The Ming Yellow River flows east to the sea south of Shandong. Jingdezhen is inland, and Ningbo and Macao are on the coast.
